# processing

```{r}

# Source the original functions
source("../original/powerBullFunctions.R")

# Define the directory where the data files are saved
dataDir = "../../../data/previous articles extracting many effect sizes/stanley et al. 2018/raw/"

# Grab the names of all of the files
nameF = list.files(path = dataDir)

# Initialize empty list to collect effect size level data
es_level_data <- list()

# Loop over each dataset
for(i in 1:length(nameF)){
  
  print(paste0("Read in and process dataset ", i, ": ", nameF[i]))
  
  # Read in dataset i (using same method as original)
  dat = read.dta13(file = paste0(dataDir, nameF[i]))
  
  # Extract the meta-analysis name (same as original)
  meta_name = strsplit(nameF[i], ".dta")[[1]]
  
  # Calculate variance (same as original)
  v = dat$SE^2
  
  # === METRIC CLASSIFICATION ===
  # Strategy 1: Check if file has dedicated d/r/correlation columns with data
  has_d_col <- "d" %in% names(dat) && sum(!is.na(dat$d)) > 0
  has_g_col <- "g" %in% names(dat) && sum(!is.na(dat$g)) > 0
  has_r_col <- "r" %in% names(dat) && sum(!is.na(dat$r)) > 0
  has_correlation_col <- "correlation" %in% names(dat) && sum(!is.na(dat$correlation)) > 0
  has_fischer_col <- "fischer" %in% names(dat) && sum(!is.na(dat$fischer)) > 0
  
  # Determine metric type for this file
  if (has_d_col || has_g_col) {
    file_metric <- "d"
  } else if (has_r_col || has_correlation_col || has_fischer_col) {
    file_metric <- "r"
  # } else {
  #   file_metric <- NA_character_
  # }
  } else {
    # Strategy 2: Use magnitude heuristic on 'es' column
    # Correlations bounded by [-1, 1], Cohen's d unbounded
    min_es <- min(dat$es, na.rm = TRUE)
    max_es <- max(dat$es, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Check proportion above 1.0 for more robust classification
    prop_above_abs_1 <- mean(min_es < -1 | max_es > -1, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (prop_above_abs_1 > 0.01) {  # If >1% of effects are above 1, likely d
      file_metric <- "d"
    } else {
      file_metric <- "unknown" # can't be said with certainty to be r, so drop
    }
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("  Classified as metric type: %s\n", file_metric))
  
  # === Calculate article-level estimates (same as original) ===
  avgES_file   = mean(dat$es, na.rm = TRUE)
  medSE_file   = median(dat$SE, na.rm = TRUE)
  I_sq_file    = RMA.est(dat$es, v)$value[7]
  FE_est_file  = as.numeric(rma(dat$es, v, method="FE")$b)
  RE_est_file  = RMA.est(dat$es, v)$value[1]
  WLS_est_file = WLS.est(dat$es, v)$value[1]
  WW_est_file  = as.numeric(WAAP.est(dat$es, v)$value[1])
  PP_est_file  = PETPEESE.est(dat$es, v)$value[25]
  
  # Calculate median power estimates
  pow_WL_file = 1 - pnorm(1.96 - abs(WLS_est_file)/medSE_file)
  pow_PP_file = 1 - pnorm(1.96 - abs(PP_est_file)/medSE_file)
  pow_WW_file = 1 - pnorm(1.96 - abs(WW_est_file)/medSE_file)
  
  # === Create effect-size level dataframe ===
  es_data <- tibble(
    # Identifiers
    meta_analysis = meta_name,
    file_name = nameF[i],
    es_index = 1:nrow(dat),
    
    # METRIC TYPE
    metric = file_metric,
    
    # Raw effect size data (what the original used)
    yi = dat$es,
    sei = dat$SE,
    vi = v,
    
    # Article-level summary statistics
    meta_k = nrow(dat),
    meta_metric = file_metric,  # Store at meta-analysis level too
    meta_avgES = avgES_file,
    meta_medSE = medSE_file,
    meta_I_sq = I_sq_file,
    meta_FE_est = FE_est_file,
    meta_RE_est = RE_est_file,
    meta_WLS_est = WLS_est_file,
    meta_WW_est = WW_est_file,
    meta_PP_est = PP_est_file,
    meta_pow_WL = pow_WL_file,
    meta_pow_PP = pow_PP_file,
    meta_pow_WW = pow_WW_file,
    
    # Effect-size level indicators
    is_adequately_powered_WLS = sei < abs(WLS_est_file)/2.8,
    is_adequately_powered_PP = sei < abs(PP_est_file)/2.8,
    is_adequately_powered_WW = sei < abs(WW_est_file)/2.8,
    
    # Effect size level power
    power_individual = 1 - pnorm(1.96 - abs(yi)/sei)
  )
  
  # Add to list
  es_level_data[[i]] <- es_data
}

# Combine all effect sizes into one dataframe
all_effect_sizes <- bind_rows(es_level_data)

# Print summary by metric type
cat("\n=== EFFECT SIZE LEVEL DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total meta-analyses: %d\n", length(nameF)))
cat(sprintf("Total effect sizes: %d\n", nrow(all_effect_sizes)))

metric_summary <- all_effect_sizes %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_meta_analyses = n_distinct(meta_analysis),
    n_effect_sizes = n(),
    n_with_data = sum(!is.na(yi) & !is.na(sei)),
    mean_yi = mean(yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_yi = median(yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_yi = min(yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_yi = max(yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nBy Metric Type:\n")
print(metric_summary)

# Split datasets by metric
dat_r <- all_effect_sizes %>% filter(metric == "r", !is.na(yi))
dat_d <- all_effect_sizes %>% filter(metric == "d", !is.na(yi))
dat_unknown <- all_effect_sizes %>% filter(!metric %in% c("d", "r"), !is.na(yi))

cat(sprintf("\nCorrelations (r): %d effect sizes from %d meta-analyses\n", 
            nrow(dat_r), n_distinct(dat_r$meta_analysis)))
cat(sprintf("Cohen's d: %d effect sizes from %d meta-analyses\n", 
            nrow(dat_d), n_distinct(dat_d$meta_analysis)))

# Save the effect-size-level dataset
write_csv(all_effect_sizes, 
          "../../../data/previous articles extracting many effect sizes/stanley et al. 2018/outputs/effect_sizes_with_metric.csv")

```

## Diagnostics of confusion of r and d

```{r}


files <- dir_ls("../../../data/previous articles extracting many effect sizes/stanley et al. 2018/raw/", glob = "*.dta")

# ============================================================
# Check each file for correspondence between es and r/d columns
# ============================================================

correspondence_check <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  dat <- read_dta(f)
  cols <- names(dat)
  
  # Initialize results for this file
  result <- tibble(
    file = basename(f),
    n_rows = nrow(dat),
    
    # Check which columns exist and have data
    has_es = "es" %in% cols,
    has_r = "r" %in% cols,
    has_d = "d" %in% cols,
    has_g = "g" %in% cols,
    has_correlation = "correlation" %in% cols,
    
    n_es = if("es" %in% cols) sum(!is.na(dat$es)) else 0,
    n_r = if("r" %in% cols) sum(!is.na(dat$r)) else 0,
    n_d = if("d" %in% cols) sum(!is.na(dat$d)) else 0,
    n_g = if("g" %in% cols) sum(!is.na(dat$g)) else 0,
    n_correlation = if("correlation" %in% cols) sum(!is.na(dat$correlation)) else 0
  )
  
  # === KEY TEST: Check if es == r or es == d ===
  
  if ("es" %in% cols && "r" %in% cols) {
    # Convert to numeric and compare es to r where both are non-missing
    es_num <- as.numeric(dat$es)
    r_num <- as.numeric(dat$r)
    both_present <- !is.na(es_num) & !is.na(r_num)
    if (sum(both_present) > 0) {
      # Check if they're identical (allowing for small floating point differences)
      es_equals_r <- all(abs(es_num[both_present] - r_num[both_present]) < 0.0001, na.rm = TRUE)
      result$es_equals_r <- es_equals_r
      result$n_both_es_r <- sum(both_present)
      result$max_diff_es_r <- max(abs(es_num[both_present] - r_num[both_present]), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      result$es_equals_r <- NA
      result$n_both_es_r <- 0
      result$max_diff_es_r <- NA
    }
  } else {
    result$es_equals_r <- NA
    result$n_both_es_r <- NA
    result$max_diff_es_r <- NA
  }
  
  if ("es" %in% cols && "d" %in% cols) {
    # Convert to numeric and compare es to d where both are non-missing
    es_num <- as.numeric(dat$es)
    d_num <- as.numeric(dat$d)
    both_present <- !is.na(es_num) & !is.na(d_num)
    if (sum(both_present) > 0) {
      es_equals_d <- all(abs(es_num[both_present] - d_num[both_present]) < 0.0001, na.rm = TRUE)
      result$es_equals_d <- es_equals_d
      result$n_both_es_d <- sum(both_present)
      result$max_diff_es_d <- max(abs(es_num[both_present] - d_num[both_present]), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      result$es_equals_d <- NA
      result$n_both_es_d <- 0
      result$max_diff_es_d <- NA
    }
  } else {
    result$es_equals_d <- NA
    result$n_both_es_d <- NA
    result$max_diff_es_d <- NA
  }
  
  if ("es" %in% cols && "g" %in% cols) {
    # Convert to numeric and compare es to g (Hedges' g)
    es_num <- as.numeric(dat$es)
    g_num <- as.numeric(dat$g)
    both_present <- !is.na(es_num) & !is.na(g_num)
    if (sum(both_present) > 0) {
      es_equals_g <- all(abs(es_num[both_present] - g_num[both_present]) < 0.0001, na.rm = TRUE)
      result$es_equals_g <- es_equals_g
      result$n_both_es_g <- sum(both_present)
      result$max_diff_es_g <- max(abs(es_num[both_present] - g_num[both_present]), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      result$es_equals_g <- NA
      result$n_both_es_g <- 0
      result$max_diff_es_g <- NA
    }
  } else {
    result$es_equals_g <- NA
    result$n_both_es_g <- NA
    result$max_diff_es_g <- NA
  }
  
  if ("es" %in% cols && "correlation" %in% cols) {
    # Convert to numeric and compare es to correlation
    es_num <- as.numeric(dat$es)
    corr_num <- as.numeric(dat$correlation)
    both_present <- !is.na(es_num) & !is.na(corr_num)
    if (sum(both_present) > 0) {
      es_equals_corr <- all(abs(es_num[both_present] - corr_num[both_present]) < 0.0001, na.rm = TRUE)
      result$es_equals_correlation <- es_equals_corr
      result$n_both_es_corr <- sum(both_present)
      result$max_diff_es_corr <- max(abs(es_num[both_present] - corr_num[both_present]), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      result$es_equals_correlation <- NA
      result$n_both_es_corr <- 0
      result$max_diff_es_corr <- NA
    }
  } else {
    result$es_equals_correlation <- NA
    result$n_both_es_corr <- NA
    result$max_diff_es_corr <- NA
  }
  
  # Add magnitude-based classification
  if ("es" %in% cols && sum(!is.na(dat$es)) > 0) {
    es_num <- as.numeric(dat$es)
    result$max_abs_es <- max(abs(es_num), na.rm = TRUE)
    result$prop_es_above_1 <- mean(abs(es_num) > 1.0, na.rm = TRUE)
    result$likely_metric <- if(result$max_abs_es > 1.05) "d" else "r"
  } else {
    result$max_abs_es <- NA
    result$prop_es_above_1 <- NA
    result$likely_metric <- NA
  }
  
  return(result)
})

# ============================================================
# Summarize findings
# ============================================================

cat("=== CORRESPONDENCE ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

cat("Files where es == r (within 0.0001 tolerance):\n")
r_matches <- correspondence_check %>%
  filter(!is.na(es_equals_r), es_equals_r == TRUE)
print(r_matches %>% select(file, n_both_es_r, max_diff_es_r))
cat(sprintf("Total: %d files\n\n", nrow(r_matches)))

cat("Files where es == d (within 0.0001 tolerance):\n")
d_matches <- correspondence_check %>%
  filter(!is.na(es_equals_d), es_equals_d == TRUE)
print(d_matches %>% select(file, n_both_es_d, max_diff_es_d))
cat(sprintf("Total: %d files\n\n", nrow(d_matches)))

cat("Files where es == g (within 0.0001 tolerance):\n")
g_matches <- correspondence_check %>%
  filter(!is.na(es_equals_g), es_equals_g == TRUE)
print(g_matches %>% select(file, n_both_es_g, max_diff_es_g))
cat(sprintf("Total: %d files\n\n", nrow(g_matches)))

cat("Files where es == correlation:\n")
corr_matches <- correspondence_check %>%
  filter(!is.na(es_equals_correlation), es_equals_correlation == TRUE)
print(corr_matches %>% select(file, n_both_es_corr, max_diff_es_corr))
cat(sprintf("Total: %d files\n\n", nrow(corr_matches)))

# ============================================================
# Check for files where es does NOT match any other column
# ============================================================

cat("Files where es exists but doesn't match r, d, g, or correlation:\n")
no_match <- correspondence_check %>%
  filter(
    n_es > 0,
    (is.na(es_equals_r) | es_equals_r == FALSE),
    (is.na(es_equals_d) | es_equals_d == FALSE),
    (is.na(es_equals_g) | es_equals_g == FALSE),
    (is.na(es_equals_correlation) | es_equals_correlation == FALSE)
  )
print(no_match %>% select(file, n_es, max_abs_es, likely_metric))
cat(sprintf("Total: %d files\n\n", nrow(no_match)))

# ============================================================
# Create classification based on correspondence
# ============================================================

cat("=== METRIC CLASSIFICATION ===\n\n")

classification <- correspondence_check %>%
  mutate(
    metric_source = case_when(
      !is.na(es_equals_r) & es_equals_r == TRUE ~ "r (es==r)",
      !is.na(es_equals_d) & es_equals_d == TRUE ~ "d (es==d)",
      !is.na(es_equals_g) & es_equals_g == TRUE ~ "g (es==g)",
      !is.na(es_equals_correlation) & es_equals_correlation == TRUE ~ "r (es==correlation)",
      !is.na(likely_metric) ~ paste0(likely_metric, " (heuristic)"),
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

classification_summary <- classification %>%
  count(metric_source) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

cat("Metric classification by source:\n")
print(classification_summary)

# ============================================================
# Detailed look at files that have both r and d columns
# ============================================================

cat("\n=== FILES WITH BOTH R AND D COLUMNS ===\n")
both_r_and_d <- correspondence_check %>%
  filter(has_r & has_d, n_r > 0, n_d > 0)

if (nrow(both_r_and_d) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Found %d files with both r and d columns containing data:\n", nrow(both_r_and_d)))
  print(both_r_and_d %>% select(file, n_r, n_d, n_es, es_equals_r, es_equals_d))
  
  # For these files, check which one es matches
  cat("\nWhich column does 'es' match in files with both r and d?\n")
  both_match <- both_r_and_d %>%
    mutate(
      es_matches = case_when(
        es_equals_r == TRUE ~ "r",
        es_equals_d == TRUE ~ "d",
        TRUE ~ "neither"
      )
    ) %>%
    count(es_matches)
  print(both_match)
} else {
  cat("No files have both r and d columns with data.\n")
}

# ============================================================
# Check for files where r/d columns exist but are empty
# while es has data
# ============================================================

cat("\n=== FILES WHERE ES HAS DATA BUT R/D COLUMNS ARE EMPTY ===\n")

empty_source_cols <- correspondence_check %>%
  filter(
    n_es > 0,
    (has_r == FALSE | n_r == 0),
    (has_d == FALSE | n_d == 0),
    (has_g == FALSE | n_g == 0),
    (has_correlation == FALSE | n_correlation == 0)
  )

cat(sprintf("Found %d files where es has data but r/d/g/correlation are missing or empty:\n", 
            nrow(empty_source_cols)))
if (nrow(empty_source_cols) > 0) {
  print(empty_source_cols %>% select(file, n_es, max_abs_es, likely_metric))
  cat("\nThese files likely had r/d data copied into 'es' during data preparation.\n")
  cat("We must rely on magnitude heuristics to classify them.\n")
}

# ============================================================
# Save detailed results
# ============================================================

write_csv(correspondence_check, 
          "../../../data/previous articles extracting many effect sizes/stanley et al. 2018/outputs/es_correspondence_check.csv")

write_csv(classification, 
          "../../../data/previous articles extracting many effect sizes/stanley et al. 2018/outputs/metric_classification.csv")

cat("\n=== RESULTS SAVED ===\n")
cat("Full correspondence check: es_correspondence_check.csv\n")
cat("Metric classification: metric_classification.csv\n")

# ============================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================

cat("\n=== FINAL SUMMARY ===\n\n")

summary_stats <- classification %>%
  summarise(
    total_files = n(),
    files_es_equals_r = sum(es_equals_r == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    files_es_equals_d = sum(es_equals_d == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    files_es_equals_g = sum(es_equals_g == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    files_es_equals_correlation = sum(es_equals_correlation == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    files_no_source_cols = sum(
      (has_r == FALSE | n_r == 0) & 
      (has_d == FALSE | n_d == 0) & 
      (has_g == FALSE | n_g == 0) &
      (has_correlation == FALSE | n_correlation == 0) &
      n_es > 0
    )
  )

print(summary_stats)

if (summary_stats$files_es_equals_r > 0 && summary_stats$files_es_equals_d > 0) {
  cat("\n⚠️ CRITICAL FINDING:\n")
  cat("The 'es' column contains DIFFERENT metrics in different files:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  - %d files where es = r (correlations)\n", summary_stats$files_es_equals_r))
  cat(sprintf("  - %d files where es = d (Cohen's d)\n", summary_stats$files_es_equals_d))
  cat("\nThe original script treats these as if they're on the same scale,\n")
  cat("which is methodologically problematic!\n")
} else if (summary_stats$files_es_equals_r > 0) {
  cat("\n✓ All files where we can check use r (correlations)\n")
} else if (summary_stats$files_es_equals_d > 0) {
  cat("\n✓ All files where we can check use d (Cohen's d)\n")
}

if (summary_stats$files_no_source_cols > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n⚠️ Note: %d files have no r/d/g/correlation columns to verify against.\n", 
              summary_stats$files_no_source_cols))
  cat("These must be classified using magnitude heuristics.\n")
}
```
